text: Two things stand out. Zeros in glucose, blood pressure, skin thickness, insulin and BMI look like missing values, not real readings. `followup_score` separates the classes almost perfectly (diabetics 35–96, non-diabetics −4–63), which suggests leakage. I'll make the split first, then test both with and without that column.
